_scope: Full Table-1 parity (8 morphologies x 2 systems x full J-V) is a CAMPAIGN, not an R0 gate (~8h/physical case at 14 s/step). E4's R0 anchor is bilayer Jsc-only (V_hat=0, light) for BOTH material systems, on the box with cuDSS.
_regime: REDUCED-DRIVE PROXY. The physical drive of either system hits the documented Debye/mesh wall (E1(ii)/E2/E5; test_xdd_run._resolvable_bilayer): physical lam2~2.2e-5 -> Debye << h -> the march blows phi_hat up and never fires the steady criterion on any feasible uniform-octree mesh. E4 therefore marches in the SAME marchable regime E1/E5 use (lam2=1e-1, Eg_hat=4, symmetric mu=0.5, eps_hat=1, weak Langevin zeta=1e-6 -- the E1 stripe knobs). The per-system material knobs that SURVIVE this regime are tau_x (via tau_inv), the Onsager separation a, and the donor:acceptor generation ratio; mu_hat, lam2, eps_hat, Eg_hat are all reduced/symmetrized.
_delta_class: REDUCED-DRIVE PROXY -- the physical Table-1 mA/cm2 anchor is NOT reproduced and is NOT expected to be. Both systems march to a CONVERGED lit steady state (criterion fired, flux self-consistency < 1e-2). The nondim |J| is the meaningful comparable quantity. The re-dimensionalised mA/cm2 OVERSHOOTS the anchor (p3ht_pcbm ratio 1343x = delta class 10^3; pm6_y6 ratio 6.12x = delta class 10^0-10^1) because the marchable regime decouples the current from the physical mobility scale: |J| is computed with symmetric mu_hat=0.5, then multiplied by the PHYSICAL J0 (= U0*x0*q, which carries the physical mobility), which double-counts the physical mobility. The honest verdict per the plan ('record the honest delta class, NOT a fake match'): physical mA/cm2 Jsc is UNREACHABLE on a uniform CPU/GPU mesh -- it is a Scharfetter-Gummel / boundary-refined-mesh R1 item (the same Debye wall). Mechanism = mesh + drive + symmetrized transport, NOT a solver defect.

cross_system_ordering._note: In the reduced-drive regime the physical PM6>P3HT ordering does NOT hold: p3ht_pcbm's tiny Onsager separation a=1e-8 gives far higher dissociation/current than pm6_y6's a=1e-7. This is a regime artifact (the surviving knobs, not the physical device), recorded honestly -- like E1's horizontal>vertical deviation. The robust E4 anchor is the per-system convergence + honest delta class, not the cross-system ordering.
